about: Painted textures for the foyer (index.html only). They are AI-generated images, not artworks: each was made from a text prompt alone, with no reference image and no artist named. The foyer's palette and motifs are drawn in CSS after Anna Vishenskaya's panels, with her blessing; none of her images were shown to any model.

generator.rights: AI-generated output; use follows xAI's terms of service. No third-party artwork was supplied as input.

processing: Picked one of four results per prompt, then resized and re-encoded as baseline JPEG with macOS sips. Re-encoding drops the original EXIF, including the signature xAI embeds in ImageDescription; original_sha256 identifies the untouched download.

textures.use: Hero sky: .hero-atmosphere::before, soft-light over each view's gradient
textures.prompt: Oil painting of a quiet sky full of soft rounded clouds, painted on a smooth gesso panel. Visible fine brushstrokes and gentle glazes. Pale silver-grey and faint lilac tones, almost monochrome, even soft light, no sun. The clouds fill the whole frame; no horizon, no land, no water, no buildings, no people, no birds, no text, no signature, no frame.

textures.use: Rooms section: .shape-section::before, fading out above the room cards
textures.prompt: Oil painting of a deep night sky, indigo fading to violet-black, scattered tiny pinpoint stars, a few thin veils of dark cloud. Fine visible brush texture on a smooth gesso panel. No moon, no horizon, no land, no water, no buildings, no people, no text, no signature, no frame.

Seamless flat texture of a hand-prepared gesso ground on a wooden panel, seen straight on. Warm ivory off-white, very fine sanding marks, faint brush ridges and tiny pits, soft even daylight. The texture fills the entire frame edge to edge; no objects, no paint, no shadows, no vignette, no text, no frame.
